comment: Global relationship of each client group by region (Account Planning, mv_global_group_relationship): one row per entity x region x product family x month-end, Apr-2023 to Sep-2026. APAC rows are SMBC APAC golden clients (committed = facility limits, drawn = drawn balances + trade instruments live at the month-end, deposits = month-end balances, revenue = gold revenue fact); JP rows are the Japanese parent and JP-booked group entities from the Tokyo HO Delta Share; EMEA / AMER rows are the regional subsidiaries from the EMEA and AMER shares. All amounts in USD (shared rows also in their booking currency). Committed, drawn and deposits are month-end balances (point-in-time: take one month, never sum across months); revenue_usd is the month's revenue (additive); revenue_12m_usd is a trailing 12-month window (point-in-time). APAC Share of Group Revenue % = SUM(revenue_12m_usd) for region APAC / SUM(revenue_12m_usd) all regions, at one month. Grain: one row per entity x region x product family x month-end.
